quest.title: A Festive First Adventure
quest.description: Tiantian of the Liyue Adventurers' Guild seems to have been working on something...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Festive Fever x100

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: Hmm... Why didn't anyone come...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is something the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: Traveler! Could... could you hear me out? So it's the Lantern Rite right now, and the Guild was looking to hitch a ride on the festive cheer to do some advertising — to see if we could snag some new recruits.

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: I hear that Brother Qian's come up with a game called... called a somethingy-screen. I don't wanna be left out!

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: So I thought up a new activity. I call it... "My First Adventure."

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: Simply put, I wanted to use some Xiao Lanterns to mark out a gliding track.

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: Then, anyone who wants to take part in this activity can just open up their wind glider and follow the Xiao Lanterns as they fly...

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: You'd get to feel the thrill of adventure and take in the beautiful sights of Liyue, with Xiao Lanterns at your side the whole way! Sounds good, right?

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: I'd originally designed two tracks, but when I went to notify the Millelith, they said that I needed to find a test flier who could evaluate them from a safety perspective first.

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: You must have a lot of adventuring experience, right? Would you mind doing the evaluation for me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's have at it.

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: Thanks so much for your help! Let's go to Mt. Tianheng, then. That's where the first track starts.

talks.objective: Go to Mt. Tianheng to look for Tiantian

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's showtime.

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: This is the finish line. You're pretty good at this, aren't you... So, how did you find it?

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: Hehe, of course! I put them there myself, you know.

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: Well then, let's go to the next track, shall we?

choices.text: The Xiao Lanterns were very pretty...

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: Alright! This is where the track begins. Once again, the Xiao Lanterns are all in place.

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: You can begin as soon as you're ready. Same deal as before, collect the lanterns as you head for the objective.

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: So, now that you've tested both tracks out, what's your overall impression?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They're not bad.

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: Great! Guess I can report back to the Millelith now.

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: I'm sure that a fun activity like this will attract lots of people to join the Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. Here's your remuneration for helping me evaluate those tracks. Please, take it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's do this.

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: This is where the track begins. See? The Xiao Lanterns are all in position.

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: Alright then — you can begin whenever you're ready. Collect the Xiao Lanterns en route to your objective.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me get warmed up first...

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: Sure, just let me know once you're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I need a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: No problem, just let me know once you're done.
